effect.name: Cosine Web 2 (Filaments)
effect.desc: Generates a drifting web of cosine interference filaments by iteratively rotating the coordinate field and accumulating sine/cosine terms at growing scales (Shadertoy port); a 1/length term adds thin bright threads. Iterations, rotation, start scale, scale growth, color multiplier, bias and gamma shape it, and it replaces the layer content.
